name: Monitor Simulation
description: View a PC's HDMI output on your Windows laptop using a USB HDMI capture device.
details:
Turn your Windows laptop into a display for another PC. Connect the PC's HDMI output to a USB HDMI capture device, then connect the capture device to the laptop and select it in Monitor Simulation.

Most laptop HDMI ports only send video out and cannot receive the PC's signal directly. The capture device provides video only; use a keyboard and mouse connected to the PC to control it. Capture quality and delay depend on the device.
